title: Rectangular prism
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on a new face. This sketch consists of a rectangular loop made up of four lines: the first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.75, 0.0); the second line starts at (0.75, 0.0) and ends at (0.75, 0.0216); the third line starts at (0.75, 0.0216) and ends at (0.0, 0.0216); the fourth line completes the rectangle by starting at (0.0, 0.0216) and ending at the origin (0.0, 0.0). Apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire sketch to reduce its size proportionally. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into a three-dimensional object by rotating it using Euler angles set to zero and translating it using a translation vector set to zero. Finally, extrude the sketch 0.0216 units along the normal direction to create a solid body. The dimensions of the final shape are 0.75 units in length, 0.021582733812949638 units in width, and 0.02158273381294964 units in height. The final shape is a rectangular prism with a flat top and bottom, a smooth surface, and uniform dimensions throughout.

# Define the initial sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0.0216).lineTo(0, 0.0216).close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.0216)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0216, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0216, 0.0216) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0216) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
# The Euler angles are (-90.0, 0.0, -90.0) and the translation vector is (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
# This transformation is equivalent to rotating the object 90 degrees around the X-axis and then 90 degrees around the Z-axis
r = r.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), 90) \
     .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), 90)
